sections.name: AboutHero
sections.note: Rule draws on delayed beat; settle and draw curves are house-chosen, but entrance rhythm is uneven

sections.name: AboutStory
sections.note: Service list is hover-only with no keyboard focus or active state; handcrafted choreography and micro-details cannot overcome missing interaction completeness

sections.name: AboutTiles
sections.note: Image hovers are hover-only (no focus-visible); desaturate-on-entry and radial choreography are crafted, but missing full state vocabulary fails the bar

sections.name: BookingSection
sections.note: ContactLink provides all four states (idle/hover/focus/active); underline-draw gesture is directional; form/contact layout separation is clear

sections.name: DualBrandSplit
sections.note: Signature section: proves token system works by rendering identical markup under both brands; motion difference (signature vs. refined) is legible in how panels move and respond to hover

sections.name: Hero
sections.note: Spec plate hover is color-only; everything else (parallax layering, magnetic drift, wipe fill, staggered assembly, scroll-cue drift) is brand-specific.

sections.name: Manifesto
sections.note: Scored out of 16; the drawn rule and horizontal type drift are deliberate in a quiet section.

sections.name: ServiceTicker
sections.note: Diamond rotation on hover is the only micro-interaction; interaction-state coverage is thin, but the counter-rotating tracks at different speeds carry the POV.

sections.name: EventIndex
sections.note: Number and title move against each other on hover, rule draws in, neighbor dimming—all content-specific. Stagger is tight (55ms) but felt.

sections.name: FinalCTA
sections.note: Micro-interactions delegated to MagneticButton and ContactLink; choreography is clear but less intricate than EventIndex.
